 


## Incipit

Buffalo 6th Sept 1859

 

My Brother Nelson

 

Yours of the 31 aug came duly to hand, was glad to recieve it -- glad more to know that I was misinformed relative to the health of Syrena perhaps I did not properly understand adaline, and as I have not her letter my be (I sent it to Ann) I may not be able to state the thing correctly
